purpose: Parser fixtures for Indian bank, UPI, wallet, ATM, transfer, card, and non-transaction alerts.
provenance_policy: Every body is an invented, redacted rewrite of a public OSS grammar or edge case. No private inbox messages, live account numbers, phone numbers, or transaction references are included.

row_schema.kind: debit, credit, refund, reversal, upcoming, card_bill, declined, failed, mandate, or non_financial
row_schema.rail: upi, card, bank_account, atm, transfer, wallet, or unknown
row_schema.expected: gold fields; transaction_amount_paise is null when no completed debit or credit should be booked
row_schema.variant_of: original row ID for a synthetic numeric variant; absent on seed rows
